description:
Take on an authentic sushi-making challenge on the Nintendo Switch™!
Pick the right toppings for each order, pair them with vinegared rice, and serve them up!
Skill and speed make all the difference!
Share Joy-Con™, and up to 4 players can join in!
Reach for the ultimate high score!

《Rules》
Make and serve as much sushi as you can within the time limit!
Earn bonus points by filling orders without any mistakes!
The key is to work efficiently! Keep an eye on which toppings and how much rice remain!

《How to Play》
1. Check the orders!

2. Slice toppings that need to be prepared ahead of time!

3. Select a topping and make sushi!

[Score Attack]
Work as fast and accurately as you can to see how many orders you can fill within the time limit!
Aim for a high score and climb to the top of the global leaderboards!

[Battle]
Battle it out in sushi showdowns with up to 4 players!
Compete in speed, accuracy, and skill to see who's the true sushi master!
name: Make it! Sushi
intro:
Make delicious sushi and become a sushi chef!
Work quickly and accurately to fill as many sushi orders as possible!
